$comment: The rule table the AST gate resolves incoming lexical findings against.
It is DATA, not a claim about what the shipped scanner detects. Three of
these ids are real shipped C/C++ rules (packages/rules/src/rules/lang-c.ts);
the two `VG-CEXEC-*` ids are gate-local, because the shipped scanner has no
C command-execution rule at all - `VG-INJ-003` covers Python os.system/os.popen
only, and its `languages` list does not include c or cpp. Measured 2026-08-07:
If a shipped C command-execution rule ever lands, replace the id here; do not
leave two ids for one construct.
`requirementKind` belongs to the RULE. `scope`, `expectedCount` and whether a
requirement is emitted at all belong to the AST. DERIVATION.md is the spec.
